featured_individuals.narrative_summary: Convicted of murder in 1994 and sentenced to death. Released via Alford Plea in 2011 after serving ~18 years. The case involved alleged coerced confessions, questionable forensic evidence, and "Satanic Panic".
Convicted of murder in 1994 and sentenced to life without parole. Released via Alford Plea in 2011 after serving ~18 years. Contributing factors were similar to Echols' case.
